gbm_population_evidence.quote: WHO Grade III Gliomas; WHO Grade IV Gliomas
Subjects with histologically or cytologically confirmed WHO grade III-IV gliomas experiencing recurrence or progression after standard treatment.

gbm_population_flag.reason: Glioblastoma is named only in the brief summary ('adult GBM patients'), not in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels; grade III-IV gliomas are eligible, so the D27B naming rule decides screening.

candidate_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] personalized dendritic cell injection ZSNeo-DC1.1 (other names: DC vaccine)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Safety and Efficacy Study for DC Vaccine in Recurrent or Progressive High-grade Gliomas

role_evidence.quote: The autologous genetic-modification-free DC cells will be loaded with multiple tumor neoantigen peptides

coder_notes: Record is for WHO grade III-IV gliomas; glioblastoma only appears in the brief summary, which does not count under D27B, so high_grade_glioma_unspecified. Both arms are experimental schedules of the same vaccine (no control), allocation NA, single group. Sequencing of tumour samples is used to make the vaccine, not as a selection biomarker.
